paragraphs.source_en: At the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Goat on the seventh day of the fifth month in the twentieth year of Keichō, Hideyori learned that Osaka had suffered a crushing defeat.

units.source_en: At the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Goat on the seventh day of the fifth month in the twentieth year of Keichō, Hideyori learned that Osaka had suffered a crushing defeat.
units.source_zh: 庆长二十年五月初七未时四刻，秀赖得知，大坂已一败涂地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长二十年五月初七未时四刻，秀赖得知，大坂已一败涂地。

paragraphs.source_en: Before then, men had been approaching the castle one after another from the northeast, but Hideyori did not know whether they were friend or foe.

units.source_en: Before then, men had been approaching the castle one after another from the northeast, but Hideyori did not know whether they were friend or foe.
units.source_zh: 在此之前，虽有人从城池东北方向陆陆续续接近，但秀赖并不知那些人是敌是友。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在此之前，虽有人从城池东北方向陆陆续续接近，但秀赖并不知那些人是敌是友。

paragraphs.source_en: Had the poorly defended Osaka Castle been attacked while the decisive battle was being fought around Okayama and Tennōji, Hideyori would have led his troops out without a moment's hesitation. Yet the man charged with surrounding the castle was the son of his aunt, Jōkōin, and she had continually sought peace between Osaka and the eastern forces... Hideyori believed that Ieyasu had no intention of killing him.

units.source_en: Had the poorly defended Osaka Castle been attacked while the decisive battle was being fought around Okayama and Tennōji, Hideyori would have led his troops out without a moment's hesitation.
units.source_zh: 假如在冈山和天王寺一带决战之时，防守薄弱的大坂城遭了攻击，秀赖自会二话不说，带兵出击。

units.source_en: Yet the man charged with surrounding the castle was the son of his aunt, Jōkōin, and she had continually sought peace between Osaka and the eastern forces... Hideyori believed that Ieyasu had no intention of killing him.
units.source_zh: 然而，负责围城的却是姨母常高院的儿子，常高院始终在大坂与关东之间游说……秀赖觉得，家康并无杀他之意。

paragraphs.source_zh: 假如在冈山和天王寺一带决战之时，防守薄弱的大坂城遭了攻击，秀赖自会二话不说，带兵出击。然而，负责围城的却是姨母常高院的儿子，常高院始终在大坂与关东之间游说……秀赖觉得，家康并无杀他之意。

paragraphs.source_en: After noon, Mōri Katsunaga sent a man to ask Hideyori to take the field in person, but Hideyori declined. Could this truly be the final battle that would decide their fate? The doubt never left him, and he kept asking himself the same question. Kimura Shigenari was dead, and Gotō Matabei, who had always spoken so vigorously at every council, was dead as well; yet to Hideyori it all seemed like a dream.

units.source_en: After noon, Mōri Katsunaga sent a man to ask Hideyori to take the field in person, but Hideyori declined.
units.source_zh: 正午之后，毛利胜永派人前来请求秀赖亲征，秀赖推拒了。

units.source_en: Could this truly be the final battle that would decide their fate?
units.source_zh: 这难道真是决定命运的最后一战？

units.source_en: The doubt never left him, and he kept asking himself the same question.
units.source_zh: 他始终存在这样的疑惑，不断自问。

units.source_en: Kimura Shigenari was dead, and Gotō Matabei, who had always spoken so vigorously at every council, was dead as well; yet to Hideyori it all seemed like a dream.
units.source_zh: 木村重成死了，在每次议事中都甚是活跃的后藤又兵卫也死了，但是，这一切对于秀赖，皆如一梦。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正午之后，毛利胜永派人前来请求秀赖亲征，秀赖推拒了。这难道真是决定命运的最后一战？他始终存在这样的疑惑，不断自问。木村重成死了，在每次议事中都甚是活跃的后藤又兵卫也死了，但是，这一切对于秀赖，皆如一梦。

paragraphs.source_en: But such reflections were no more than conjecture and lay far from Hideyori's true state of mind. By then, his own life no longer mattered so much to him. As for the courage to take the field, he possessed it still. Yet try as he might, he could feel no enmity toward the armies of the east, and little by little his will to fight ebbed away.

units.source_en: But such reflections were no more than conjecture and lay far from Hideyori's true state of mind.
units.source_zh: 但是，这种叹息不过只是推断，与秀赖的真实心思相去甚远。

units.source_en: By then, his own life no longer mattered so much to him.
units.source_zh: 此时，对于秀赖，性命已不再那般重要。

units.source_en: As for the courage to take the field, he possessed it still.
units.source_zh: 若说出征的勇气，他还是有的。

units.source_en: Yet try as he might, he could feel no enmity toward the armies of the east, and little by little his will to fight ebbed away.
units.source_zh: 但，关东诸军无论如何也无法让他心生敌意，他逐渐失去了斗志。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但是，这种叹息不过只是推断，与秀赖的真实心思相去甚远。此时，对于秀赖，性命已不再那般重要。若说出征的勇气，他还是有的。但，关东诸军无论如何也无法让他心生敌意，他逐渐失去了斗志。

paragraphs.source_en: The banners of the Echizen army rose over Chausuyama, and after Sanada Yukimura fell in battle, Osaka's troops at Okayama vied with one another to retreat. By the Hour of the Monkey, the battle had been decided.

units.source_en: The banners of the Echizen army rose over Chausuyama, and after Sanada Yukimura fell in battle, Osaka's troops at Okayama vied with one another to retreat.
units.source_zh: 茶磨山插上了越前军的旗帜，真田幸村战死之后，冈山的大坂军争先恐后撤退。

units.source_en: By the Hour of the Monkey, the battle had been decided.
units.source_zh: 申时，战况已定。

paragraphs.source_zh: 茶磨山插上了越前军的旗帜，真田幸村战死之后，冈山的大坂军争先恐后撤退。申时，战况已定。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyori was still inside the Sakura Gate of the main enclosure when a report came: “Ikeda Toshitaka has crossed the river and is closing upon the castle gate.” The words had scarcely been spoken when the gravely wounded Ōno Harunaga was carried into the castle.

units.source_en: Hideyori was still inside the Sakura Gate of the main enclosure when a report came: “Ikeda Toshitaka has crossed the river and is closing upon the castle gate.”
units.source_zh: 秀赖尚在本城的樱御门之内，有人来报：“池田利隆已过了河，逼近城门。”

units.source_en: The words had scarcely been spoken when the gravely wounded Ōno Harunaga was carried into the castle.
units.source_zh: 刚刚说完，身受重伤的大野治长被人抬进城内。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀赖尚在本城的樱御门之内，有人来报：“池田利隆已过了河，逼近城门。”刚刚说完，身受重伤的大野治长被人抬进城内。

paragraphs.source_en: Even then, Hideyori had no sense that he had been defeated; it had been the same during the previous winter's campaign. He had never stood upon a battlefield and knew neither victory nor defeat. But suddenly he declared, “I shall take the field too and fight to the death!”

units.source_en: Even then, Hideyori had no sense that he had been defeated; it had been the same during the previous winter's campaign.
units.source_zh: 即便如此，秀赖仍然无战败之感，去岁冬役时亦是如此。

units.source_en: He had never stood upon a battlefield and knew neither victory nor defeat.
units.source_zh: 他从未历战阵，不知胜，亦不知败。

units.source_en: But suddenly he declared, “I shall take the field too and fight to the death!”
units.source_zh: 但他突然道：“我也上阵，拼死一战！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 即便如此，秀赖仍然无战败之感，去岁冬役时亦是如此。他从未历战阵，不知胜，亦不知败。但他突然道：“我也上阵，拼死一战！”

paragraphs.source_en: He said this because Sanada Daisuke, standing beside him, had learned of his father's death and was weeping uncontrollably. In the end, however, Hideyori was unable to leave the castle. Just as he was about to mount his horse, Hayami Kai-no-kami, retreating from Tennōji, stopped him.

units.source_en: He said this because Sanada Daisuke, standing beside him, had learned of his father's death and was weeping uncontrollably.

ja.t: にしたのは、そばにいた

units.source_zh: 他这般说，乃是看到身边的真田大助得知了父亲死讯，泪流满面。

units.source_en: In the end, however, Hideyori was unable to leave the castle.

ja.t: ることができなかった。

units.source_zh: 然而，秀赖最终未能出得城去。

units.source_en: Just as he was about to mount his horse, Hayami Kai-no-kami, retreating from Tennōji, stopped him.

ja.t: しとどめたからである。

units.source_zh: 因为他正要上马之时，从天王寺撤回的速水甲斐守阻止了他。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他这般说，乃是看到身边的真田大助得知了父亲死讯，泪流满面。然而，秀赖最终未能出得城去。因为他正要上马之时，从天王寺撤回的速水甲斐守阻止了他。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, the victorious eastern armies had pursued their quarry as far as the third enclosure, and some men had even broken inside. Only then did Hideyori's heart begin to waver. A great fire in the kitchens of the main enclosure then sent him into a rage. Along with the flames spread a rumor that the kitchen overseer, Ōsumi Yoemon, seeing the eastern forces pressing ever closer, had deliberately set the fire in collusion with the enemy.

units.source_en: By then, the victorious eastern armies had pursued their quarry as far as the third enclosure, and some men had even broken inside.
units.source_zh: 这时，乘胜追击的关东诸军已逼近三道城，甚至有人闯入。

units.source_en: Only then did Hideyori's heart begin to waver.
units.source_zh: 秀赖心中这才开始动摇。

units.source_en: A great fire in the kitchens of the main enclosure then sent him into a rage.
units.source_zh: 本城厨下的大火又令他勃然大怒。

units.source_en: Along with the flames spread a rumor that the kitchen overseer, Ōsumi Yoemon, seeing the eastern forces pressing ever closer, had deliberately set the fire in collusion with the enemy.

paragraphs.source_zh: 这时，乘胜追击的关东诸军已逼近三道城，甚至有人闯入。秀赖心中这才开始动摇。本城厨下的大火又令他勃然大怒。与大火一起弥漫的，还有一个传闻，便是厨监大隅与右卫门见关东步步紧逼，故意纵火通敌。

paragraphs.source_en: Had the man truly betrayed them? Before Hideyori could learn the truth, still worse news arrived: the Echizen troops who had entered the third enclosure had set fire to Ōno Harunaga's residence, and the blaze was growing by the moment.

units.source_en: Had the man truly betrayed them?
units.source_zh: 此人真的通了敌？

units.source_zh: 未等秀赖得到确切答案，又传来了一个更大恶讯：闯进了三道城的越前军放火烧了大野治长府邸，火势愈来愈大。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此人真的通了敌？未等秀赖得到确切答案，又传来了一个更大恶讯：闯进了三道城的越前军放火烧了大野治长府邸，火势愈来愈大。

paragraphs.source_en: “The second enclosure is in imminent danger. My lord, return to the main enclosure at once!” Hayami Kai-no-kami, who had only just rushed out, came running back and ordered Hideyori's banners and horse insignia placed in the Thousand-Mat Hall of which the Taikō had once been so proud. The two fires had now thrown everyone into panic, and many were fleeing in all directions.

paragraphs.source_en: They seemed to have forgotten Hideyori; seated upon raised tatami mats, they were hastening to end their own lives...

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyori's eyes opened so wide they seemed ready to burst. The figure before him was Shōeini, the mother of Kuranosuke, and her life was slowly ebbing away.

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, an inexplicable fury rose in Okuhara Shinjūrō's breast. He felt an impulse to fling Harunaga from his back—it was this man's indecision that had ultimately brought about so vast a tragedy. Yet Shinjūrō did not hate Harunaga so deeply, for Harunaga had forgotten all concern for his own life and worried only for Hideyori and Lady Yodo. Indeed, Harunaga's final hope was identical to the purpose for which Okuhara Shinjūrō Toyomasa had strained every sinew.
